title: 27th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهِ فَضْلَ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) provide me with the merits of the Destiny Night,

verses.arabic: وَصَيِّرْ اُمُوْرِيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْعُسْرِ اِلَى الْيُسْرِ،
verses.translation: convert my affairs from difficulty into easiness,
and let off my sins and burdens.
O He Who is kind to His righteous servants!
